newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian palm oil up at close on export data.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian palm oil up at close on export data.

text.p: PALMOIL FUTURES PALMOIL PHYSICALS
Nov (3rd pos) 1,217 rgt/tonne Sep (south) 1,230 *
Open/hi/low 1,193/1,218/1,189 Prev close 1,220
Prev settlement 1,196 * sellers prices

PALMOIL FUTURES - Prices extend gains on good Aug export estimates from cargo surveyor SGS. Talk Indonesia is in the market for palm oil products due to domestic supply tightness also helping prices. Profit-taking well absorbed. Market seen holding firm in near term.
PALMOIL PHYSICALS - Firm on further covering due to good export business. Trades confined to crude palm oil and olein.
The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority put official July exports at 646,017 tonnes, the second highest monthly figure ever recorded.

Traders said players were expecting further imports from India despite a denial by the State Trading Corporation (STC) on Friday that it was in the market for up to 250,000 tonnes of palm oil for September/October shipment.
Traders said total palm oil exports from Malaysia and Indonesia are estimated to be more than 200,000 tonnes. India imported 113,000 tonnes in July, they said.
Traders said last week's news that China has approved imports of 1.3 million tonnes of palm oil between August 1996 and March 1997 would also help support prices in the near term.
There was also talk that Indonesia was in the Malaysian market for palm oil products due to tight domestic supply, but this could not be confirmed by traders.
Sharp advances last week and weaker Chicago soyoil futures on Friday had prompted profit-taking at the opening but selling was well absorbed by a bullish market.
Benchmark third position Nov crude palm oil futures closed up 21 ringgit at 1,217 ringgit ($488.17) a tonne.
Total turnover on the futures market was 3,795 lots against 3,902 on Friday.
Physical Sep (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,230 ringgit ($493.38) a tonne with bids at 1,225. It was traded up to 1,225 ringgit.
Sep (central) was offered at 1,220 with bids at 1,210, and Sep (north) saw offers at 1,210 and bids at 1,200.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,245 ringgit with bids at 1,235, after trading from 1,230 to 1,240.
Oct (central) saw offers at 1,235 ringgit and bids at 1,225 and Nov (south) at 1,255 against 1,245.
Among refined products, Sep RBD palm olein was offered at $575 a tonne, FOB Malaysia, Oct at $565 and Nov/Dec at $560. Sep was traded at $572.50, Oct at $560 and $562.50, and Nov/Dec at $557.50.
Sep and Oct/Nov/Dec RBD palm oil were offered at $530.
Sep RBD palm stearin noted sellers at $430, Oct at $427.50 and Nov/Dec at $430.
Sep and Oct/Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate were offered at $330.
